detail.longDescription: Do you run multiple AI agents in terminals, in bots, concurrently remotely and locally? Does it get overwhelming to know which agent is actually doing what, and where they are in their progress? Meet https://statuspan.com Open source, free, no strings attached, StatusPan is a quick local "departures board" for you and your agents. There's virtually no setup; just point your agents at the website, they install StatusPan and start pushing notification to it. If you're working on one machine, that's all you need. If you're doing multiple machines, your agents will install a Cloudflare relay and sync through there. I made this because I routinely run 10+ agents; some run on my Mac (in terminal and via Grok Bot), others run DGX Spark, and others are remote on a Hetzner server. At some point I couldn't tell who is actually doing what anymore, and needed a quick way to sync them all. Now I just check StatupsPan, and only follow up with agents that are clearly stuck or failed. If you find this helpful, hit me up on X (kirillzubovsky) and let me know. Thanks, hope it helps, and Happy Thanksgiving!
